findings.claim: Publishes a named individual's identity (a manager's name) sourced from a third-party business aggregator rather than a primary/business-owned source, on a site that is unsolicited and whose source is now publicly visible on GitHub.
findings.evidence: site-data.ts comment confirms the name was verified via a Birdeye aggregator listing. This is the only repo in the batch naming a specific employee, as opposed to a sole owner-practitioner whose own booking page is the business itself.
findings.fix: Given the elevated exposure from this repo being public, consider whether naming a specific employee is necessary for the concept pitch, or re-confirm via a primary source before keeping it.
